definition: Assemble a weighted or sharp summatory observable from a main pole contribution, nontrivial-zero contributions, trivial-zero and archimedean terms, endpoint conventions, and a certified remainder.
canonical_schema: observable = main_poles + nontrivial_zeros + trivial_zeros + archimedean_terms + endpoint_terms + certified_error
claim_ceiling: assembly graph only; no explicit formula is proved

constraints: x not a prime power unless endpoint convention is stated
formula depends on the chosen normalization
warning: stored as a classical target shape, not derived or authorized by this unit

schema: sum_n Lambda(n) w(n/x) <-> pole terms - sum_rho M[w](rho)x^rho + trivial/archimedean terms

items: listing zeros does not prove convergence of their sum
functional-equation symmetry does not prove RH
a correct main term does not certify the error term
a smooth kernel does not create arithmetic cancellation
finite zero truncations do not prove an exact explicit formula

forward: labelled prime-power valuation points provide Lambda-weighted coefficient geometry before global aggregation
reverse: an assembled explicit-formula value does not reconstruct the original valuation points or prime powers
loses: complex zero geometry cannot be recovered from PVG alone
Gamma and contour data are external to finite-prime valuation geometry
